scope: Caller-scoped GET /bff/agora/servant; reads the existing servant profile through the configured read store.

acceptance.provisioned_profile: GET returns the caller's servant profile in the agora.servant.v1 envelope.
acceptance.unprovisioned: GET returns RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND (404); no creation or fallback is performed.
acceptance.authorization_and_scope: Viewer role is accepted; tenant and user scope are resolved from the caller identity.
acceptance.foreign_user: A different user receives 404 rather than another user's profile.
